posts.author: MoyuNeko
posts.body:
Hello, I'm very new to rpg maker mv. Had 0 experience with codings and etc. Currently trying to make my first own rpg.
I searched up and down for the informations about how to keep portrait throughout the whole game and able to turn it on and off with a button. ( example in the attachment, sorry for my bad drawing ) Had no luck other than just showing pictures only when event dialogues happens. Helps would very much be appreciated.
Sorry for my bad English, it's not my first language.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
I might not be understanding correctly, but it looks like you'd just use the Show Picture event command.
If you want the player to turn it on and off with a button, you can make a parallel process that checks for that button and shows or erases the picture.
An easier method would be Yanfly's Button Common Events.

I am very grateful for your help!
All the tutorial I came across requires player to first interact with something then only the picture appears. I was hoping I could keep the pictures on without any trigger or switches from the start of the game.
And for example, tab key to make it reappear or disappear, is it something only plugin can achieve?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Have you done basic MV tutorials? Especially for events?
MoyuNeko said:
All the tutorial I came across requires player to first interact with something then only the picture appears. I was hoping I could keep the pictures on without any trigger or switches from the start of the game.
Click to expand...
That's what Autorun or parallel events are for. Your first map of the game, place an Autorun or parallel event, give it Show Picture, then turn on a self switch to go to a blank second page and never run again.
MoyuNeko said:
And for example, tab key to make it reappear or disappear, is it something only plugin can achieve?
Click to expand...
Yes. You can use the Conditional Branch event command to check for a button being pressed, but there are multiple buttons that belong to each of those commands.
If you want a specific button that you choose (Tab), you'd use a plugin like I said above.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
MoyuNeko said:
keep the pictures on without any trigger or switches from the start of the game.
Click to expand...
Put the show picture command in an autrorun event on the first map, then self switch the event off. If you want a key press to toggle the picture on and off you'll need to create a parallel common event checking for that key to be pressed or use a plugin like Hakuen Studio Button Common Events.

Well, you should certainly do all of the tutorial that actually comes with MV, in the Help menu.
I'd suggest you look up and do several tutorials that go over how to work with events and cutscenes.
There's a series by Echo607, Driftwood Gaming, Sir Onion Knight. I haven't looked at any of Laughing Man Productions, and I'm unimpressed with chigoo. But any of the others are worth going through - they may say the same things, but some of them may explain different parts, or explain it differently.

posts.author: ISC
posts.body:
You've already received some very interesting answers. I'd like to add a suggestion regarding the choice of button key. By default, RPG Maker only allows you to use certain button keys. To expand this range, you need to write 2 simple scripts. I'll refer you to the post where it's discussed. Be mindful of the key press method, as there are 3 of them, and each is suited for a different purpose.
how to check if a button is pressed?
like for example, show an image when Q is pressed
